Job Description: Job Description:
**Content Manager \- Foodservice (Graphic Design)**

 **We’re a naan traditional company…**

 **Summary**

  

We are seeking a dynamic and creative Content Manager to lead the development of impactful, insights\-driven content that elevates our Foodservice presence across North America. The ideal candidate has a foundational understanding of Foodservice Marketing and a passion for building great brands, content, and marketing tools. This position contributes to the continued growth of FGF Brands by developing our foodservice presence, owning all content marketing initiatives, supporting our sales team with impactful and strategic storytelling, design execution, and brand stewardship. Your goal is to drive engagement, build awareness, and accelerate conversion through strategic content, campaigns, and tools. This role requires:

* Ability to draw on relevant insights and communicate with impact
* Creativity, with an eye for detail, and a knack for visual communications
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration
* Understanding of Foodservice, our customer base, and the brands which we represent
* Experience creating and editing content using Adobe Creative Suite tools


As a key member of the Foodservice Marketing team, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional partners (Sales, Culinary, Brand, PLM) and external agencies to bring our brands to life across a wide range of customer touchpoints. The overall goal of this role is to create engaging content, marketing tools, and event support for our sales initiatives that resonates with our audience, drives awareness and trial, and optimizes the path to conversion. You’re a visual thinker, a strong communicator, and a master of creative problem solving with a passion for great food and great design.

 **What FGF Offers:**

* FGF believes in Home Grown Talent, accelerated career growth with leadership training. Unleashing Your Potential
* Competitive Compensation, Health Benefits, \& a generous flexible medical / Health spending account
* RRSP matching program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Discount program that covers almost everything under the sun \- Restaurants, gyms, shopping etc.

 **Primary Responsibilities**

* Act as brand steward to create and implement a content marketing strategy for Foodservice, ensuring alignment with FGF’s strategic priorities, brand guidelines, and visual identity across all channels
* Lead and execute the development of creative briefs and marketing materials in partnership with internal teams and agencies, ensuring alignment on messaging, objectives, and execution plans while managing timelines, approvals and production logistics
* Evolve and maintain the visual identity and storytelling for Foodservice marketing, collaborating on social media planning and producing content tailored for own brands, brokers, and distributors.
* Establish metrics to track content effectiveness (e.g., engagement rates, conversion, download/share rates).
* Build strong cross\-functional relationships (sales, culinary, brand, PLM, etc.) and coordinate with marketing agencies to deliver impactful initiatives and campaigns.
* Manage content calendars and multi\-channel campaigns to support sales initiatives, new product launches, and social media presence including development and execution of marketing strategies, sampling programs and communication plans.
* Design and produce high\-impact marketing tools and customer\-facing materials (e.g., sell sheets, social posts, email campaigns, tradeshow content, website assets).
* Create event content, including tradeshow booth visuals, sampling collateral, and presentations.
* Identify emerging content platforms (e.g., short\-form video, interactive sales tools) and pilot their use in campaigns. Propose new formats or technologies (e.g., motion graphics, content automation, AI tools) to improve content efficiency and impact.
* Stay ahead of foodservice industry and design trends, ensuring content remains fresh, relevant, and aligned with audience needs.
* Work with Sales to gather feedback and continuously evolve marketing assets to better meet customer needs.
* Lead creative brainstorming sessions and content planning workshops to foster collaboration and innovation.
* Mentor co\-op students and/or junior designers; provide creative feedback and guidance.

 **Required Skills and Experience**

  

* College or university degree and 3\-5 years of Marketing or Graphic Design experience
* Strong computer skills, with a comprehensive knowledge of Microsoft (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and Adobe (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator) applications
* Familiarity with motion design, video editing tools (e.g., Premiere Pro, After Effects), or AI\-powered creative platforms is an asset
* 3–5 years of experience in a content\-focused marketing role, with a portfolio of visual work
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and to set priorities according to key business needs
* Strong design sensibility and attention to visual detail
* Excellent communication and writing skills
* Ability to synthesize insights and translate strategy into creative, results\-oriented content
* Successfully build and maintain relationships in a collaborative team environment
* Embrace our company culture of *speed, change, and uncertainty* where initiative, leadership, flexibility, and an entrepreneurial nature are drivers for success
* Experience working with and managing external agency partners and relationships
* Passion for food, creativity, and building standout brand experiences

 **What is the recipe for a great career at FGF?**  

  

Working at FGF Brands, there is never a dull moment! As a successful company that is continually growing there is always challenging yet rewarding work to be a part of. We have an entrepreneurial spirit which encourages all our team members to use their own creativity and out of the box thinking to come up with solutions and new ideas.  

  

In compliance with Ontario’s Bill 190, we confirm that this posting represents a current, existing vacancy within our organization.  

  

**Disclaimer:** The above describes the general responsibilities, required knowledge and skills. Please keep in mind that other duties may be added or this description may be amended at any time.

Job Description: The Centre for Addiction and Mental Health (CAMH) is seeking a full\-time, 12\-month contract, Research Coordinator within in the Institute for Mental Health Policy Research (IMHPR). IMHPR is a key driver in building the knowledge base for policy decisions, development of mental health interventions, and health system improvement. The area of focus is on climate change and health and implications for populations experiencing poverty. Reporting to the Principal Investigator and Research Manager and working with a range of partners, your duties will include but are not limited to multiple administrative tasks, database management, original research including interviews, REB communications, and supporting learners, and stakeholder communications. You will contribute to scoping and systematic reviews and knowledge mobilization activities. Lived expertise and Indigenous engagement are key aspects of this work. You will support a healthy workplace that embraces diversity, encourages teamwork and complies with all applicable and regulatory requirements, and encourages recovery\-oriented care. This position is primarily located at 250 College Street and 1025 Queen Street West.


  
Responsibilities
  
Qualifications

The successful candidate must possess a Masters level degree in a health policy\-focused field, with at least two (2\) years of relevant experience and training related to equity deserving/systemically disadvantaged populations. Experience with literature reviews, qualitative research, and interdisciplinary teams in the area of climate justice, housing and health equity, intersectionality, and health equity is required. Experience collaborating with lived/community experts is required. Demonstrated experience developing and administering data collection tools using online data capture platforms such as REDCap within a research setting is required. Experience with Covidence for literature reviews is required. Experience communicating and coordinating with external stakeholders is required. Proficiency in PC software skills, including Microsoft Office and internet search engines is required. Detail oriented, well\-organized, with a strong technical aptitude is required. Knowledge mobilization skills are required. You possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written); and function well within a cooperative, collaborative working environment. You have the ability for self\-directed learning/working; while working concurrently on multiple projects. You possess strong knowledge and understanding of research design, data management, and ethical conduct of research in human participants, including GCP, RCR, and TCPS2 certification. Candidates must be able to work effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds, and with individuals with severe mental health challenges. Bilingualism (English/French) and/or proficiency in another language, lived expertise in areas pertinent to this project, and experience working with Indigenous peoples and communities are all assets.


Salary Range: $37\.51 \- $50\.60 per hour


**CAMH is a fully affiliated teaching hospital and research institute of the University of Toronto. As a CAMH employee, you will contribute to our mission by supporting teaching, research, and clinical care across the hospital.**  

**CAMH is dedicated to equity, diversity, and inclusion. Our commitment is to foster a workplace, teaching, and learning environment that is inclusive, respectful, and free from discrimination or harassment.**  

**CAMH strongly encourages applications from candidates who reflect the diversity of the communities we serve, including First Nations, Métis, and Inuit Peoples; Black and other racialized communities; LGBTQ2S\+ communities; women; and people with disabilities, including those with lived experience of mental health and substance use challenges.**  

**We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Thank you to all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. If you require accommodations during the application or recruitment process, please let us know.**

* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration
* Understanding of Foodservice, our customer base, and the brands which we represent
* Experience creating and editing content using Adobe Creative Suite tools


As a key member of the Foodservice Marketing team, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional partners (Sales, Culinary, Brand, PLM) and external agencies to bring our brands to life across a wide range of customer touchpoints. The overall goal of this role is to create engaging content, marketing tools, and event support for our sales initiatives that resonates with our audience, drives awareness and trial, and optimizes the path to conversion. You’re a visual thinker, a strong communicator, and a master of creative problem solving with a passion for great food and great design.

* FGF believes in Home Grown Talent, accelerated career growth with leadership training. Unleashing Your Potential

* Discount program that covers almost everything under the sun \- Restaurants, gyms, shopping etc.

* Lead and execute the development of creative briefs and marketing materials in partnership with internal teams and agencies, ensuring alignment on messaging, objectives, and execution plans while managing timelines, approvals and production logistics
* Evolve and maintain the visual identity and storytelling for Foodservice marketing, collaborating on social media planning and producing content tailored for own brands, brokers, and distributors.
* Establish metrics to track content effectiveness (e.g., engagement rates, conversion, download/share rates).
* Build strong cross\-functional relationships (sales, culinary, brand, PLM, etc.) and coordinate with marketing agencies to deliver impactful initiatives and campaigns.
* Manage content calendars and multi\-channel campaigns to support sales initiatives, new product launches, and social media presence including development and execution of marketing strategies, sampling programs and communication plans.
* Design and produce high\-impact marketing tools and customer\-facing materials (e.g., sell sheets, social posts, email campaigns, tradeshow content, website assets).
* Create event content, including tradeshow booth visuals, sampling collateral, and presentations.
* Identify emerging content platforms (e.g., short\-form video, interactive sales tools) and pilot their use in campaigns. Propose new formats or technologies (e.g., motion graphics, content automation, AI tools) to improve content efficiency and impact.
* Stay ahead of foodservice industry and design trends, ensuring content remains fresh, relevant, and aligned with audience needs.
* Work with Sales to gather feedback and continuously evolve marketing assets to better meet customer needs.
* Lead creative brainstorming sessions and content planning workshops to foster collaboration and innovation.
* Mentor co\-op students and/or junior designers; provide creative feedback and guidance.

 **Required Skills and Experience**

  

* College or university degree and 3\-5 years of Marketing or Graphic Design experience
* Strong computer skills, with a comprehensive knowledge of Microsoft (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and Adobe (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator) applications
* Familiarity with motion design, video editing tools (e.g., Premiere Pro, After Effects), or AI\-powered creative platforms is an asset
* 3–5 years of experience in a content\-focused marketing role, with a portfolio of visual work
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and to set priorities according to key business needs
* Strong design sensibility and attention to visual detail
* Excellent communication and writing skills
* Ability to synthesize insights and translate strategy into creative, results\-oriented content
* Successfully build and maintain relationships in a collaborative team environment
* Embrace our company culture of *speed, change, and uncertainty* where initiative, leadership, flexibility, and an entrepreneurial nature are drivers for success
* Experience working with and managing external agency partners and relationships
* Passion for food, creativity, and building standout brand experiences

 **What is the recipe for a great career at FGF?**  

  

Working at FGF Brands, there is never a dull moment! As a successful company that is continually growing there is always challenging yet rewarding work to be a part of. We have an entrepreneurial spirit which encourages all our team members to use their own creativity and out of the box thinking to come up with solutions and new ideas.

* Creativity, with an eye for detail, and a knack for visual communications
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration
* Understanding of Foodservice, our customer base, and the brands which we represent
* Experience creating and editing content using Adobe Creative Suite tools


As a key member of the Foodservice Marketing team, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional partners (Sales, Culinary, Brand, PLM) and external agencies to bring our brands to life across a wide range of customer touchpoints. The overall goal of this role is to create engaging content, marketing tools, and event support for our sales initiatives that resonates with our audience, drives awareness and trial, and optimizes the path to conversion. You’re a visual thinker, a strong communicator, and a master of creative problem solving with a passion for great food and great design.

 **What FGF Offers:**

* FGF believes in Home Grown Talent, accelerated career growth with leadership training. Unleashing Your Potential
* Competitive Compensation, Health Benefits, \& a generous flexible medical / Health spending account

* Discount program that covers almost everything under the sun \- Restaurants, gyms, shopping etc.

* Act as brand steward to create and implement a content marketing strategy for Foodservice, ensuring alignment with FGF’s strategic priorities, brand guidelines, and visual identity across all channels
* Lead and execute the development of creative briefs and marketing materials in partnership with internal teams and agencies, ensuring alignment on messaging, objectives, and execution plans while managing timelines, approvals and production logistics
* Evolve and maintain the visual identity and storytelling for Foodservice marketing, collaborating on social media planning and producing content tailored for own brands, brokers, and distributors.
* Establish metrics to track content effectiveness (e.g., engagement rates, conversion, download/share rates).
* Build strong cross\-functional relationships (sales, culinary, brand, PLM, etc.) and coordinate with marketing agencies to deliver impactful initiatives and campaigns.
* Manage content calendars and multi\-channel campaigns to support sales initiatives, new product launches, and social media presence including development and execution of marketing strategies, sampling programs and communication plans.
* Design and produce high\-impact marketing tools and customer\-facing materials (e.g., sell sheets, social posts, email campaigns, tradeshow content, website assets).
* Create event content, including tradeshow booth visuals, sampling collateral, and presentations.
* Identify emerging content platforms (e.g., short\-form video, interactive sales tools) and pilot their use in campaigns. Propose new formats or technologies (e.g., motion graphics, content automation, AI tools) to improve content efficiency and impact.
* Stay ahead of foodservice industry and design trends, ensuring content remains fresh, relevant, and aligned with audience needs.
* Work with Sales to gather feedback and continuously evolve marketing assets to better meet customer needs.
* Lead creative brainstorming sessions and content planning workshops to foster collaboration and innovation.
* Mentor co\-op students and/or junior designers; provide creative feedback and guidance.

 **Required Skills and Experience**

  

* College or university degree and 3\-5 years of Marketing or Graphic Design experience
* Strong computer skills, with a comprehensive knowledge of Microsoft (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and Adobe (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator) applications
* Familiarity with motion design, video editing tools (e.g., Premiere Pro, After Effects), or AI\-powered creative platforms is an asset
* 3–5 years of experience in a content\-focused marketing role, with a portfolio of visual work
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and to set priorities according to key business needs
* Strong design sensibility and attention to visual detail
* Excellent communication and writing skills
* Ability to synthesize insights and translate strategy into creative, results\-oriented content
* Successfully build and maintain relationships in a collaborative team environment
* Embrace our company culture of *speed, change, and uncertainty* where initiative, leadership, flexibility, and an entrepreneurial nature are drivers for success
* Experience working with and managing external agency partners and relationships
* Passion for food, creativity, and building standout brand experiences

 **What is the recipe for a great career at FGF?**  

  

Working at FGF Brands, there is never a dull moment! As a successful company that is continually growing there is always challenging yet rewarding work to be a part of. We have an entrepreneurial spirit which encourages all our team members to use their own creativity and out of the box thinking to come up with solutions and new ideas.

**Content Manager \- Foodservice (Graphic Design)**

 **We’re a naan traditional company…**

 **Summary**

  

We are seeking a dynamic and creative Content Manager to lead the development of impactful, insights\-driven content that elevates our Foodservice presence across North America. The ideal candidate has a foundational understanding of Foodservice Marketing and a passion for building great brands, content, and marketing tools. This position contributes to the continued growth of FGF Brands by developing our foodservice presence, owning all content marketing initiatives, supporting our sales team with impactful and strategic storytelling, design execution, and brand stewardship. Your goal is to drive engagement, build awareness, and accelerate conversion through strategic content, campaigns, and tools. This role requires:

* Ability to draw on relevant insights and communicate with impact
* Creativity, with an eye for detail, and a knack for visual communications
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration
* Understanding of Foodservice, our customer base, and the brands which we represent
* Experience creating and editing content using Adobe Creative Suite tools


As a key member of the Foodservice Marketing team, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional partners (Sales, Culinary, Brand, PLM) and external agencies to bring our brands to life across a wide range of customer touchpoints. The overall goal of this role is to create engaging content, marketing tools, and event support for our sales initiatives that resonates with our audience, drives awareness and trial, and optimizes the path to conversion. You’re a visual thinker, a strong communicator, and a master of creative problem solving with a passion for great food and great design.

 **What FGF Offers:**

* FGF believes in Home Grown Talent, accelerated career growth with leadership training. Unleashing Your Potential
* Competitive Compensation, Health Benefits, \& a generous flexible medical / Health spending account
* RRSP matching program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Discount program that covers almost everything under the sun \- Restaurants, gyms, shopping etc.

 **Primary Responsibilities**

* Act as brand steward to create and implement a content marketing strategy for Foodservice, ensuring alignment with FGF’s strategic priorities, brand guidelines, and visual identity across all channels
* Lead and execute the development of creative briefs and marketing materials in partnership with internal teams and agencies, ensuring alignment on messaging, objectives, and execution plans while managing timelines, approvals and production logistics
* Evolve and maintain the visual identity and storytelling for Foodservice marketing, collaborating on social media planning and producing content tailored for own brands, brokers, and distributors.
* Establish metrics to track content effectiveness (e.g., engagement rates, conversion, download/share rates).
* Build strong cross\-functional relationships (sales, culinary, brand, PLM, etc.) and coordinate with marketing agencies to deliver impactful initiatives and campaigns.
* Manage content calendars and multi\-channel campaigns to support sales initiatives, new product launches, and social media presence including development and execution of marketing strategies, sampling programs and communication plans.
* Design and produce high\-impact marketing tools and customer\-facing materials (e.g., sell sheets, social posts, email campaigns, tradeshow content, website assets).
* Create event content, including tradeshow booth visuals, sampling collateral, and presentations.
* Identify emerging content platforms (e.g., short\-form video, interactive sales tools) and pilot their use in campaigns. Propose new formats or technologies (e.g., motion graphics, content automation, AI tools) to improve content efficiency and impact.
* Stay ahead of foodservice industry and design trends, ensuring content remains fresh, relevant, and aligned with audience needs.
* Work with Sales to gather feedback and continuously evolve marketing assets to better meet customer needs.
* Lead creative brainstorming sessions and content planning workshops to foster collaboration and innovation.
* Mentor co\-op students and/or junior designers; provide creative feedback and guidance.

 **Required Skills and Experience**

  

* College or university degree and 3\-5 years of Marketing or Graphic Design experience
* Strong computer skills, with a comprehensive knowledge of Microsoft (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and Adobe (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator) applications
* Familiarity with motion design, video editing tools (e.g., Premiere Pro, After Effects), or AI\-powered creative platforms is an asset
* 3–5 years of experience in a content\-focused marketing role, with a portfolio of visual work
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and to set priorities according to key business needs
* Strong design sensibility and attention to visual detail
* Excellent communication and writing skills
* Ability to synthesize insights and translate strategy into creative, results\-oriented content
* Successfully build and maintain relationships in a collaborative team environment
* Embrace our company culture of *speed, change, and uncertainty* where initiative, leadership, flexibility, and an entrepreneurial nature are drivers for success
* Experience working with and managing external agency partners and relationships
* Passion for food, creativity, and building standout brand experiences

 **What is the recipe for a great career at FGF?**  

  

Working at FGF Brands, there is never a dull moment! As a successful company that is continually growing there is always challenging yet rewarding work to be a part of. We have an entrepreneurial spirit which encourages all our team members to use their own creativity and out of the box thinking to come up with solutions and new ideas.
